title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff & regional failover during traffic surge
author: Priya Nair
commits: fix: correct exponential backoff when regional cooldown == 0
perf: reduce lock contention during failover decision path
feat: expose load-shed telemetry event for alerting and debugging
test: add integration test for multi-region failover under surge
description:
Motivation: During a customer incident on 2026-02-09 we observed the SLO enforcer incorrectly computing exponential backoff when a region's cooldown value was zero. This caused rapid regional failover attempts and cascading load-shedding, exacerbating the outage. This hotfix stabilizes backoff calculations, relaxes ephemeral circuit-breaker thresholds during detected traffic surges, and improves coordination so only one region performs failover at a time.

Summary of changes: consolidated backoff logic into a single, well-tested function; guard the failover coordinator with a try-lock to avoid simultaneous failovers; increase CB error threshold by 2x for transient HTTP 5xx bursts; add a telemetry event (slo_enforcer.load_shed_decision) to help troubleshoot why requests are shed; add an integration test simulating a cross-region surge.

Checklist:
- [x] Reproduced the issue with a regression test (integration test simulates surge + zero-cooldown)
- [x] Fixed backoff math and added unit tests for edge cases (zero, one, large cooldowns)
- [x] Added telemetry and dashboards to observe load-shedding decisions
- [x] Ran canary and observed stable behavior under synthetic load
- [x] Obtained SRE approval for threshold adjustments

High-level commits: fix: correct exponential backoff when regional cooldown == 0; perf: reduce lock contention during failover decision path; feat: expose load-shed telemetry event for alerting and debugging; test: add integration test for multi-region failover under surge.

Files touched (high-level): services/slo-enforcer/src/backoff.rs (core fix + unit tests), services/slo-enforcer/src/circuit_breaker.rs (threshold tuning), services/slo-enforcer/src/coordinator.rs (try-lock coordination), infra/k8s/slo-enforcer-deployment.yaml (adjusted liveness probe and resources for canary), observability/metrics/slo_enforcer.yaml (new metric + dashboard), services/slo-enforcer/tests/regional_failover_integration.rs (end-to-end regression).
